1.content:
# Alert Volume Reduction

Identify top alert contributors, recurring root causes, flapping problems, and temporal patterns to prioritize alert tuning and noise reduction. Set the dashboard timeframe to **30 days** for full analysis.

2.title: Total Problems
2.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems
| expand affected_entity_ids
| lookup [
    fetch dt.entity.host | fields id, managementZones
    | append [fetch dt.entity.custom_device | fields id, managementZones]
    | append [fetch dt.entity.service | fields id, managementZones]
    | append [fetch dt.entity.process_group | fields id, managementZones]
  ], sourceField: affected_entity_ids, lookupField: id
| summarize
    mzs_nested = collectDistinct(lookup.managementZones),
    event.category = takeAny(event.category),
    event.name = takeAny(event.name),
    event.start = takeAny(event.start),
    event.end = takeAny(event.end),
    event.status = takeAny(event.status),
    root_cause_entity_id = takeAny(root_cause_entity_id),
    root_cause_entity_name = takeAny(root_cause_entity_name),
    ap_raw = takeAny(labels.alerting_profile),
    by:{display_id}
| fieldsAdd mz_list = arrayRemoveNulls(arrayFlatten(mzs_nested))
| fieldsAdd mz_list = if(arraySize(mz_list) == 0, array("(No Management Zone)"), else: mz_list)
| filter arraySize(array($ManagementZone)) == 0 or arraySize(array($ManagementZone)) > 200 or in("*", array($ManagementZone)) or contains(toString(array($ManagementZone)), "3420b2ac") or iAny(in(mz_list[], array($ManagementZone)))
| fieldsAdd ap_list = if(isNull(ap_raw) or arraySize(ap_raw) == 0, array("(No Alerting Profile)"), else: ap_raw)
| filter arraySize(array($AlertingProfile)) == 0 or arraySize(array($AlertingProfile)) > 200 or in("*", array($AlertingProfile)) or contains(toString(array($AlertingProfile)), "3420b2ac") or iAny(in(ap_list[], array($AlertingProfile)))
| summarize total = count()
